Hello!

I really like your style, can you please draw my 2 characters?

-The character with the darker skin and wavy hair is 175 cm. He's a scientists' assistant who helps his boss with his daily life. 

-The character with messy black hair and glasses is 148 cm.
a mad scientist who saved his assistant's life. He is very intelligent but can be very eccentric. Sometimes his experiments can be messy but he always manages to keep his assistant alive.

Their relationship is not normal. Please draw what comes to mind! Thank you.

Close ups of their faces:
https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/633866543909830666/1074594916627390514/FDC5510F-A017-425F-B7A3-C2A8C7F84C58.png

https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/633866543909830666/1074596354313162832/image.png

Full body references:
https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/633866543909830666/1074596326173589534/image.png

How I plan to use:
-Print, physical media for myself
-Reference for future commission art

Please send high resolution PSD data if possible.

Hello, nice to meet you. Please draw these two characters together sitting on a small couch. The man is wearing a Roman purple toga and laurel wreath. The man is watching TV and the girl is sleeping next to him with her head leaning on the man's shoulder. The girl is wearing pajamas as in the reference photo. Her face has some scars as shown in the photo.

The costume in the reference photo is not very good. If possible, please make it look like an ancient Roman toga.

Men: https://i.imgur.com/RUxhjJb.png
Girls: https://imgur.com/a/8ZD0TXU

Thank you very much.

はじめまして
かっこよくてかわいいイケメンたちに一目惚れしました！

よければムーンライトノベルスやエブリスタに掲載している自作BL小説、触手を飼うの受けと攻め（＋触手）をお願いします

■あらすじ
大学生の小田原瞬平はバイト帰りの橋の上で瀕死の触手を拾った。
弱った触手をほうっておけずアパートに連れ帰り、見切り品弁当のからあげを与え、様々な芸を仕込む瞬平。
友人の沢尻は瞬平が飼い始めた内緒のペットを知りたがるが、のらりくらり適当にごまかす。
とはいえ現実は非情である。
最初はキモかった触手がだんだん可愛く見えてきた頃、恐るべき「本性」を目の当たりにして……。

■描いてほしいキャラ
瞬平（20）
強気平凡受け
トイプーの飼い主の大学生。
性格　少々お調子者　ドジ　面倒見が良い
趣味　YouTubeで犬猫動画を視聴すること
好物　バイト先のコンビニの見切り品のからあげ弁当

沢尻（20）
イケメン隠れオタク攻め
大学生　瞬平の友人　見た目はモデルのようにシュッとした高身長のイケメン
周囲には内緒にしてるが実は宇宙人マニア
瞬平に片想い
性格　スマート　誠実　友達想い　趣味の話になると饒舌になる

この二人の2ショット＋ピンク色の触手をお願いします
触手はマスコット風にデフォルメされたもので

雰囲気
ほのぼの　仲良し　キュート　ポップ

モチーフにしてもらえると嬉しいもの
UFO　SF　星　宇宙
・強制ではありません。採用していただける場合は一個でも複数組み合わせでもご自由にどうぞ

受け攻めのキャラデザはカッチリ決まってないので、お好みでどうぞ
矛盾点や不明点おまかせ　アレンジ歓迎

完成品はネット小説の表紙・挿絵・宣伝ほか、kindleで販売している電子書籍の表紙に使わせてください
お名前とTwitterアカウントは明記します

ご縁がございましたらよろしくお願いします

Hello, I'd like to request you to draw a BL couple of my original characters. I would like to request you to draw a BL couple of my original characters because your illustrations are so beautiful, especially the faces.

Character
Name: Julius (offensive)
About 28 years old
Male
Blond, long slightly wavy hair
He has blue eyes and long eyelashes.
About 185cm, slightly muscular, broad shoulders and thin waist.
He is the crown prince of a certain country. He is a prince of a certain country. His personality is selfish, arrogant, and a little S-ish.


Name: Asad
He is about 25 years old.
He has black hair.
Eyes purple.
About 178cm
Brown skin, muscular (soft macho, more than Julius)
He is a former slave gladiator. His personality is cool, serious, unsociable, and stoic.

Originally, Asad (the receiver) tried to kill Julius (the aggressor) and felt a thrill and excitement he had never felt before, and then Asad liked him and started keeping him close.
Basically, Julius is the one who pushes the button, and Assad is the one who rejects him at first, but gradually they are bonding, but he is still not used to being honest with her. (tsundere).
I hope you can freely write the situations and poses as you think of them.

I've uploaded some notes and reference images of the characters below, but they are just images, and you are free to arrange them however you like!

If you don't like it, or if it is not worth the price, you can cancel your order.

We would be very happy to have Tsuna draw our child, so please give us your consideration.

https://www.dropbox.com/sh/278jrzplu33r99b/AADMogZwXfk9AyiL7NwaiiTQa?dl=0

It is nice to meet you.
I saw your wonderful illustration on Twitter and would like to make the following request.
If you find it difficult, please feel free to cancel the request.

◻Character
(1) Leader (aggressive)
Good at taking care of others/not being honest/good at housework
Height:190cm/ Age:22 years old
https://www.dropbox.com/s/6uj1gp78g63o3w1/kishimen.png?dl=0

(2) Leader (Receiver)
Mood-maker/tormentor/brotherly
Height: 180cm/Age: 21
https://www.dropbox.com/s/1l6yhjbjz2xlm9s/napori.png?dl=0

Common information
Underground idol / They share a room / They are good friends both publicly and privately and are treated as "Nicoichi" / They are not in a relationship (one-way aggressive).

Both images are based on picrew's "Harinezuban Danshi Maker (2)" (https://picrew.me/image_maker/1453974).

◻️Situation
Sorry for the out of the box request, but we would like you to draw a scene of the above two in their daily life.
There are no detailed specifications, except that we would like them to be close to each other physically.
We would be happy if they are close to each other.

◻Purpose of use → for personal viewing and appreciation

We wish you the best of luck in your future endeavors.
We understand that you are busy, but we would appreciate your consideration.
